Name: Harvest Grain Bowl
Description: Warm barley and roasted squash with charred sweetcorn, baby leaves and a lemon-herb dressing, finished with toasted seeds. Served with a drink.

Name: Ember Chicken Bowl
Description: A grilled chicken fillet sliced over warm barley, with charred sweetcorn, baby leaves and a smoked paprika dressing. Served with a drink.

Name: Ember Fillet Burger
Description: A grilled chicken fillet in a toasted brioche bun with crisp lettuce, tomato and our house ember sauce. Comes with regular fries and a regular drink.

Name: Little Owl Nuggets
Description: Six lightly breaded chicken bites, sized for smaller appetites, with a regular side and a small drink.

Name: Roast Plate
Description: Two pieces of slow-roasted chicken with regular fries, a regular side and a dip of your choosing.

Name: Twin Fillet Plate
Description: Two grilled fillets with two house dips, a regular side and a drink. Straightforward and generous.

Name: Grill Sampler
Description: Two pieces of roast chicken, two grilled mini fillets and a pair of glazed wings, for when you cannot choose.

Name: Double Ember Stack
Description: Two grilled fillets stacked with melted cheese, pickles and ember sauce in a toasted bun. With regular fries and a drink.

Name: Sharing Box for Two
Description: Six glazed wings, four pieces of roast chicken and two grilled fillets, with two regular fries. Enough for two, at a push three.

Name: Family Roast Box
Description: Fourteen pieces of slow-roasted chicken with four regular fries. Built for a table rather than a tray.

Name: Party Platter
Description: Fourteen pieces of roast chicken, eight grilled mini fillets, eight glazed wings, a large tub of golden bites, two large sides, six regular fries and a large bottle of cola to share.

Name: Dipper's Dozen
Description: Twelve grilled mini fillets and a large tub of golden bites with four house dips: smoked barbecue, ember hot, sweet chilli and garlic buttermilk. Four regular fries and two large sides included.

Name: Ten-Piece Grill Box
Description: Eight glazed wings, ten pieces of roast chicken and four grilled mini fillets, with four regular fries.

Name: House Fries
Description: Skin-on fries, fried golden and left unsalted so you can season them the way you like them.

Name: Sweetcorn Cob
Description: A short cob of sweetcorn, char-grilled and brushed with herb butter. Suitable for vegetarians.

Name: Golden Bites
Description: Small pieces of lightly breaded chicken breast. A bite-sized snack that shares badly and travels well.

Name: Smoky Beans
Description: Slow-cooked beans in a smoked tomato sauce. The plain, dependable side.

Name: Garden Salad
Description: Crisp leaves with sweetcorn, tomato and a buttermilk dressing on the side.

Name: Cherry Swirl Sundae
Description: Soft-serve ice cream under a cherry sauce, with a spoon that is never quite long enough.

Name: Chocolate Swirl Sundae
Description: Soft-serve ice cream under a dark chocolate sauce, finished with cocoa crumb.

Name: Caramel Waffle Shake
Description: A thick shake blended with waffle pieces and salted caramel, topped with soft-serve and more caramel.

Name: Four Oat Cookies
Description: Four oat and dark chocolate cookies, baked soft in the middle.

Name: Owlet Cola
Description: Our own cola, poured over ice. Chilled and thirst-quenching.

Name: Owlet Cola No Sugar
Description: The same cola with no sugar in it. Chilled and thirst-quenching.

Name: Citrus Press
Description: A crisp lemon and lime press, unsweetened and served over ice.

Name: Apple and Blackcurrant
Description: Pressed apple with blackcurrant, served long over ice.

Name: Still Water
Description: Still water, chilled. Simple and essential.

Name: Hot Chocolate
Description: Steamed milk with dark chocolate, topped with a spoon of cream.
